_comment: The ticketing-tickets package's rights, shipped as a library layer (docs/commerce_PRD.md §4.11). They name only its
own types and only @authenticated: no slot, so no application has to bind anything. Every type is organization-owned
(X8): Organizations' row rule narrows each right to the members of the seller organization, so the right alone shows
a signed-in user nothing of another seller.
Tickets, devices and scans are read-only here: this package's services write them. Holders reach their own tickets
through /spark/ticketing/tickets (secret or holding account), door devices through their event-scoped token.
Opt out of all of these with "libraries": { "ticketing-tickets": false }.
